item.title: Comment on Congratulations to Christopher Rufo and Richard Hanania by Karl Pooper
item.description:
Reply to Ytreporp:

Federal employee here. I am surprised by the swiftness and the lack of controversy with which this is being implemented at my office. References to diversity and inclusion are being deleted all over our internal documents and guidance and diversity and inclusion goals are disappearing from our strategic planning materials. Nobody seems to be resisting.

I believe it was Matt Yglesias who said on Twitter the other day that given the election results, not even Democrats seem to believe that these programs make for good politics.

It's a preference cascade. People will look back in wonder that we allowed the most deranged 1% of the population to imposed racist policies on our entire society. If more brave people stood up along the way, it would have ended much sooner.
